ranked_evidence.snippet: Image 3: Nara Chandrababu Naidu. Nara Chandrababu NaiduTelugu Desam Party leader Nara Chandrababu Naidu.(more). N. Chandrababu Naidu, born on April 20, 1950, is an Indian politician currently serving as the chief minister of Andhra Pradesh. He heads the Telugu Desam Party (TDP) and began his fourth term as chief minister in 2024. He was a confidant of Sanjay Gandhi and was elected to the Andhra Pradesh state legislative assembly in 1978, later becoming a minister. In 1995, he became leader of the TDP and chief minister of Andhra Pradesh. N. Chandrababu Naidu has served multiple terms as chief minister of Andhra Pradesh state in southeastern India. He is the head of the Telugu Desam Party (TDP). N. Chandrababu Naidu is associated with the Telugu Desam Party (TDP), a regional political party in Andhra Pradesh, India. Naidu is currently serving his fourth term as chief minister of Andhra Pradesh.
